name: MiroFish v0.1 Swarm Intelligence Engine
description: Simulate many AI agents to explore how events and opinions unfold.

upstream.version: main @ 7657031 (2026-10-01; app code last changed 2026-07-23, 103 commits after v0.1.2) on the v0.1.2 image's Python environment

PORT.description: Caddy port (public domain target); only /healthz and /health skip the login.

BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME.description: Login name for the MiroFish UI and API (letters, digits, . _ @ -).

BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Login password for the MiroFish UI and API. Generated; read it here.

MIROFISH_BACKEND.description: Private address of the MiroFish backend that /api/* is forwarded to.

PORT.description: Backend (Flask) listen port; Railway health-checks /health on it.

LLM_API_KEY.description: Required. API key of your OpenAI-compatible LLM provider (billed by that provider).

LLM_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (OpenAI, DashScope, OpenRouter, vLLM, ...).

LLM_MODEL_NAME.description: Model id used for graph building, agent personas, simulation and reports.

ZEP_API_KEY.description: Required. Zep Cloud API key (app.getzep.com) for the knowledge graph and agent memory.

OASIS_DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS.description: Default simulation rounds. More rounds = many more LLM calls and cost.

LLM_BOOST_API_KEY.description: Optional. Second OpenAI-compatible key; parallel runs use it for the Reddit agents.

LLM_BOOST_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL for LLM_BOOST_API_KEY (set all three LLM_BOOST_* or none).

SECRET_KEY.description: Flask secret key (generated; replaces upstream's built-in default).

FLASK_DEBUG.description: Keep false. true turns on Flask debug mode, never for a public deployment.

FLASK_HOST.description: Listen address. :: serves IPv4 and IPv6; use 0.0.0.0 only if IPv4-only is needed.

MIROFISH_CPU_THREADS.description: Optional. Torch/BLAS threads for simulations; empty = from CPU quota, max 8.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Shutdown grace so running simulation processes are stopped cleanly on redeploy.
